character.description: small green goblin-like minion with pointed ears, glowing yellow-green eyes, dark tunic and boots, south-facing combat animation

idle.action: alert compact breathing idle with both feet on the shared baseline

walk.action: clear small four-step walk cycle with planted foot contacts

run.action: quick compact run cycle, recognizably faster than walk

attack_charge.action: lower body, raise claws, and prepare a short melee lunge

attack_execute.action: clear claw melee lunge and follow-through, no detached effects

recover.action: return from lunge to alert ready stance

hit.action: small readable recoil, full body retained

death.action: controlled compact collapse with no detached limbs
